purpose: Define the only two representation-level corrections allowed in validator V2 before any isolated V4 candidate seal, precheck, or scientific postcheck.

allowed_representation_changes.old_rule: JSON null and HDF5 NaN compare unequal.
allowed_representation_changes.new_rule: For fields declared nullable numeric by the sealed output schema, JSON null/empty CSV and HDF5 NaN are semantically equivalent representations of missing numeric data.
allowed_representation_changes.forbidden_extension: Finite numbers, infinities, booleans, strings, roots, residuals, rho, stable, critical, counts, and statuses may not use this equivalence.

allowed_representation_changes.new_rule: COMPACT_SCALAR_DELAY_AUGMENTATION selected points must use NOT_APPLICABLE_COMPACT_SELECTED; FULL_Q_ORDINARY_HISTORY_COMPANION selected points must use DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY_KNOWN_COMPACT_CONDITIONING.
allowed_representation_changes.forbidden_extension: No route-specific, point-specific, rho-dependent, MATLAB-dependent, or result-dependent override is allowed.
